entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Hi, Sarah... I'm calling because I need to return something. I bought a helmet and... I just really need to send it back.
I can certainly look into that for you. Do you have the order number handy?
Yes, it's VF-8675309. I've been a loyal customer for a while, and I just... I was hoping this would be a simple process. Things are a bit tight financially right now.

I understand completely. Let me pull up that order. Okay, I see the Aero Road Helmet, purchased about 57 days ago. To make sure I get you to the right place, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the helmet? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

Oh, there's nothing wrong with it at all! I bought it as a gift, but the color wasn't what they wanted. I feel terrible about it. The box is still completely unopened, just as it arrived. I chose VeloFit for the safety features, but now it's just sitting here.
Thank you for clarifying that for me. It's completely understandable. Since it's a standard item and you received it 57 days ago, let me just confirm our return policy.
Okay... I'm just really hoping you can help. I was counting on getting that money back.
I have good news. You are well within our 90-day return window. Since the box is unopened, I can approve a full refund for you right now. I'll email you a prepaid shipping label immediately.
Oh, really? Wow. That's... that's such a relief. Thank you so, so much, Sarah. You have no idea how much this helps.

You are very welcome. I'm glad I could resolve this for you. The email is on its way. Just print the label, attach it to the box, and drop it off at any shipping center. Once we receive the helmet, your refund will be processed in 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can assist with?
No, that's perfect. Thank you again for being so helpful.
It was my pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
